clue.text: Anterior part of cochlea on bats aids sonar

indicators.note: bats in the sense of crazy, so the letters that follow are scrambled
the front part of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: the word supplying its front letter
taken as written into the mix

explanation.surface: An anatomy note: the front of the inner ear lets bats navigate by echoes.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface leans on bats' echolocation, but 'bats' is the anagram signal, not the animals.
explanation.definitionFit: ASDIC was the early British name for underwater echo-ranging equipment, the forerunner term for sonar.

clue.text: Check spirit imbibed by non-drinker plugging possibly Victorian and German outlooks

clue.text: Country cottage of father in provinces with Earl Grey?

clue.text: English duke resident in central section of Sichuan, its capital

clue.text: Barking mad tirade about back muscles?

clue.text: Wisdom that originally arises about conifer, whence this perfume base comes

clue.text: Male sect doing drugs chop and take drugs, none of them finishing narcotic dried fruit

clue.text: Swimmer down under recalled some magnanimity
